correctness.rationale: For R even, the leading radical-inverse digit decides upper/lower half of [0,1), hence ξ_n depends only on n mod R and is balanced with partial sums O(R). Uniform bounded-generator Lie local Taylor error is τ² ξ_j[A,B]/2+O(τ³). Product telescoping and summation by parts with W_{n,j+1}−W_{n,j}=O(τ) give bounded signed commutator sum and O(Nτ³)=O(τ²) remainder. For R odd, the central base-R digit alone recurses; block sums yield S_{m(R^k−1)/(R−1)−1}=1−mk. For A=E12,B=E23, AB=E13 is central and BA=0, so exact product equals exp(T(A+B)+τ² S_N E13/2) on e3 and yields the claimed norm for every N. For R=2 successive factors group into symmetric Strang propagation. All limits hold at fixed T, bounded A,B, exact subflows.
